core.name: Open data files
core.summary: Load recorded data from a file. The formats that open depend on the data loader extensions installed (for example CSV, MCAP, ULog or Parquet). Each loaded file becomes its own dataset, and several can be loaded side by side.
core.entry_point: File → Open Data File..., or Sources panel → File → Load a data file
core.evidence: pj_app/src/MainWindow.cpp#tr("Open Data File..."); pj_app/src/ui/LeftPanel.ui#Load a data file

core.name: Command-line data loading
core.summary: Open data with repeatable -d / --datafile options or positional file paths. Files finish loading before an optional layout; explicit files replace the sources saved in that layout.
core.entry_point: Desktop command line: plotjuggler4 -d first.csv -d second.csv -l shared.pj4.xml; plotjuggler4 recording.csv
core.verified: MainWindowStartupTest: multi-file ordering, source replacement, failure settlement and data-only startup

core.name: Live streaming
core.summary: Plot data while it arrives from a live source. The sources come from streaming extensions (for example MQTT, ZeroMQ, UDP or ROS 2). A stream can be paused, and the buffer length sets how many seconds of data are kept. With some sources a topic only starts receiving data once it is dropped into a view. Right-click a single topic or series to force streaming of its whole topic before displaying it. With multiple rows selected, the streaming menu stays hidden so right-dragging two scalar series can create an XY plot.
core.entry_point: Sources panel → Stream → choose the source in the list → + (Start streaming)
core.evidence: pj_app/src/ui/LeftPanel.ui#tabStream; pj_app/src/ui/LeftPanel.ui#Start streaming; pj_app/src/ui/CurveListPanel.cpp#Drop it into a view to start streaming; pj_app/src/ui/CurveListPanel.cpp#void CurveListPanel::showTopicContextMenu
core.verified: 2026-10-21 in-app on release-4.1 e275111c: the Stream page, the source list and the + (Start streaming) button

core.name: Record streams to MCAP
core.summary: While streaming, record what the active streams receive into standard MCAP files, one file per stream, so the session can be opened again later. The folder is set in Preferences, on the Recording page.
core.entry_point: Sources panel → Stream → record button (Record the subscribed topics of every active stream, one MCAP file per stream)

core.summary: Browse, install, update, disable and remove extensions: data loaders, streaming sources, message parsers and toolboxes. An extension can also be installed from a local ZIP file. The Help menu lists the extensions installed.

core.name: Datasets panel
core.summary: Every loaded file or stream is a dataset, listed with its topics and fields as a tree. The filter box searches by name, three buttons show or hide plot series, 2D image topics and 3D scene topics, and right-clicking a dataset offers Info, Merge, Reload, Replace and Remove.
core.entry_point: Datasets panel → Filter... box; right-click a dataset for its options

core.name: Custom Topics
core.summary: Create new series and 2D/3D objects computed from existing series and object topics, with a Luau or Python function, in the Transform Editor. Custom topics are listed in their own panel and can be edited or deleted there. Built-in filters can also be applied to the curves of a plot from that plot's right-click menu (Apply Filter...).

limitations.summary: PlotJuggler 4 only receives and displays data; it cannot publish messages or send commands back to a robot or device.
Loaded data cannot be edited: individual values cannot be changed or deleted, and the original file is never modified. A whole dataset can only be reloaded, replaced, merged or removed.
Enabling or disabling an extension, and adding or removing a custom plugin folder, takes effect only after PlotJuggler is restarted.
limitations.evidence: pj_marketplace/include/pj_marketplace/extension_manager.hpp#applies on the next launch; pj_runtime/include/pj_runtime/ExtensionCatalogService.h#Changes apply on next launch

limitations.summary: Not every live source can be recorded: a stream whose extension writes its data directly instead of passing the raw messages to PlotJuggler is left out of a recording.
A live stream cannot be merged with other datasets while it is streaming; it has to be stopped first.
limitations.evidence: pj_app/src/DatasetMergeActions.cpp#Stop streaming the live source before merging
